root_cause: The pre-mutation Taiwan refresh recreated source-ingest from the previous release image with the new configuration (host list without www.twse.com.tw); the old code still connected to the removed host, exited 1, and the restore then reported a controlled-env mismatch. Same class as the 2026-11-08 TAIFEX deadlock.
